caption: Model Response
description: One source record reporting content of a model response. A response with several records yields several events sharing response_uid; assembly is a query, not a stored claim.
name: model_response

1.caption: Partial
1.description: The record reports a non-final view of the response (no terminal stop reason or state).

2.caption: Completed
2.description: The record reports a terminal state for the response.

cli_agent.description: The CLI agent is stored once per run in run.json shared.cli_agent (0.2.0); it is present on an event only in a self-contained export.

basis.description: Rules applied by the mapping: the activity_id rule and, when the source reports no response identifier, the declared generation rule for response_uid.

data.description: Native record fields not represented elsewhere on the event (residual).
